mapper.select: select * from ( select row_number() over() AS rowno, a.* from stt_scene a where a.scene_id like '%' || #{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by a.scene_id) r where r.rowno <= 50

select * from ( select row_number() over() AS rowno, UTL_MATCH.edit_distance_similarity(a.scene_name, #{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as similarity, a.* from stt_scene a where a.scene_name like '%' || #{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by similarity desc) r where r.rowno <= 50
